description: Canadair CT-133 Silver Star Mk 3 displayed at the roundabout outside the Politécnico Militar de Aeronáutica (PMA), the FAB technical school in southern Cochabamba. Aerospotter lists FAB-617 (c/n T33-488, ex C-GWHL, delivered December 1977) as 'used as a spares source'; OpenStreetMap maps it here as a monument with ref FAB-617. The first FAB-634 also ended at the PMA as an instructional airframe (scrapped c.1997). No dated photo found; confirm on site.
